steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Galaga Legions DX Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the Windows release ZIP and populate game with your own files. Steam Deck uses the same Windows build through compatibility software.
